= Disks

Stores the cache entries as files in a location on the filesystem. 

Tilegroxy doesn't form clusters so a high-availability deployment with this cache pointing to a local filesystem will lead to inconsistent behaviour.

No automatic cleanup process is included inside of `tilegroxy` itself. It is recommended you use an external job to avoid running out of disk space.

How entries are arranged on disk is controlled by `layout`. Sub-directories are created as tiles are cached. Layer names are sanitized by replacing potentially dangerous characters with an underscore. This can lead to exotically named layers colliding. Be cognizant of that risk when using this cache.

Cache entries are written to a temporary file (in the same directory) and then renamed, so an interrupted write won't leave partial files behind. The temp files should get automatically removed, but if you see any old files ending with `.tmp`, feel free to clean them up.

Entries can optionally be stored gzip compressed by listing content types in `gzip`. Only tiles whose content type is in that list are compressed, so formats that are already compressed such as PNG and JPEG can be left out to avoid wasting CPU. Vector tiles usually compress well. Tiles that are already gzip compressed are stored as-is. Tiles with no content type are matched by the type Go detects from their contents. Compressed and uncompressed entries are detected automatically when read, so `gzip` can be changed at any time without clearing the cache.

Name should be "disk"

Configuration options:

[cols="1,3,1,1,1"]
|===
| Parameter  | Description | Type | Required | Default

| path
| The absolute path to the directory to store cache entries within. Directory (and tree) will be created if it does not already exist
| string
| Yes
| None

| filemode
| A https://pkg.go.dev/io/fs#FileMode[Go filemode] as an integer to use for all created files/directories
| uint32
| No
| 0777

| layout
| How cache entries are arranged within `path`. Either `flat` for one file per entry directly inside the directory, or `coordinate` for a `layer/z/x/y` directory tree
| string
| No
| flat

| gzip
| Content types (such as `application/vnd.mapbox-vector-tile`) of tiles to store gzip compressed. Parameters such as `charset` are ignored when matching
| string[]
| No
| None
|===

Example:

[,json]
----
"cache": {
  "name": "disk",
  "path": "./disk_tile_cache",
  "gzip": ["application/vnd.mapbox-vector-tile", "application/json"]
}
----
